title: The keys copy walk moves the playhead the way the ruler moves it now
goal: A walk that checks copying animation keys between two titles fails since dragging along the ruler started drawing a range: its drags meant to move the playhead now draw a range and let go of the title, so the panel it reads is gone. The walk should move the playhead the way a person now would.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-28 14:45: Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build keys-copy-between -> 'keys-copy-between-layers-walk 20s FAILED step 63 (expect): no control called "Key" in "Scale" is in the panel to read; the ones that are: Key Scale 1, Key Scale 2, ...'. The loop's rotating check at 2026-09-28T20:19:50Z (queue/loop.log) reports the same failure right after 99b2fc1c (ruler range) landed, before the marquee task's code existed. Steps 61 and 64 are windowDrag at y=750 (the ruler row) from x=600 (about 0:02.3, away from the playhead at 0:03), so the ruler reads them as a new range (RulerRange.grip -> .newRange), markRulerRange selects nothing, and the Scale key row leaves the panel. Fix: start those drags on the playhead (x about 709) or replace them with clickRuler at the seconds they land on (about 2.9 and 2.96).
acceptance: Its playhead moves go through the playhead or a click on the ruler, not a drag started away from the playhead

log.note: 2026-09-28 (Command Z task): the walk's undo at step 103 is now proven: a copy with steps 61-67 removed runs to the end, dip flat after shortcut Undo. Step 63 still fails as this task describes; nothing else in the walk blocks it.
